info.title: Strawberry Marshmallow
info.synopsis: Ichigo Mashimaro segue la vita di Nobue Ito, sua sorella minore Chika, e le sue amiche Miu e Matsuri.

episodes.title: Episodio 1
episodes.synopsis: Chika, Miu and Matsuri notice that it's Nobue's birthday and plan to make her a gift by themselves.

tmdb.synopsis: Chika, Miu and Matsuri notice that it's Nobue's birthday and plan to make her a gift by themselves.

episodes.title: Episodio 2
episodes.synopsis: After moving to Japan from England, Ana starts at the same class as Matsuri and pretends to know nothing about Japan or Japanese.

tmdb.title: Episodio 2

episodes.title: Episodio 3
episodes.synopsis: Ana invites Matsuri at her place to help her study English. But much to her grief, the entire gang decides to tag along.

episodes.title: Episodio 4
episodes.synopsis: Nobue finds out she's ran out of money to buy cigarettes and tries to find a fitting part-time job. Ana, Matsuri, Chika and Miu do their best and worst to help her.

episodes.title: Episodio 7
episodes.synopsis: Miu is shooting a video documentary for school, and chooses the Itō household as her subject. In the end, Nobue takes the gang out for a beach trip.

episodes.synopsis: Chika discovers she's gained a bit of weight, and, provoked by Miu, starts her own diet. It's only after a pointful remark by Nobue, that Chika's self-confidence gets restored.
